policy.admission: A candidate enters this file only when its official page answered 2xx on the day shown as first_seen (scripts/agent-watch-admit.mjs). origin=curated: hand-written seed with en+zh descriptions; origin=mcp-registry: listing from the official MCP registry, description = the publisher’s own words.
